products.name: batman
products.description: Handmade Batman crochet amigurumi superhero keychain. Stitched with durable dark charcoal and yellow milk cotton yarn, complete with bat cowl and sturdy metal key ring.
products.materials: 100% Milk Cotton Yarn, Fiberfill, Stainless Steel Keyring
products.careInstructions: Spot clean only with a slightly damp cloth.

products.name: spiderman toy
products.description: Handcrafted Spiderman superhero crochet plush amigurumi. Stitched with vibrant red and royal blue premium milk cotton yarn, featuring signature web pattern and embroidered expressive eyes.
products.materials: 100% Premium Milk Cotton Yarn, Polyester Fiberfill, Embroidered Felt Accents
products.careInstructions: Spot clean with mild soapy water or gentle hand wash. Lay flat to dry.

products.name: Lilac Cloud Ruffle Crochet Hair Scrunchie
products.description: Voluminous, snag-free crochet scrunchie crafted around a durable elastic band. Protects hair from friction and breakage while adding romantic elegance to any updo or wrist.
products.materials: Ultra-soft mercerized cotton yarn, High-stretch seamless elastic core
products.careInstructions: Hand wash with shampoo or gentle soap, air dry.

products.name: Sunflower boquet
products.description: Vibrant handcrafted crochet sunflower bouquet with cheery golden blossoms and sweet mini daisies. Wrapped in rustic kraft paper with a luxury satin bow that never wilts.
products.materials: 100% Hypoallergenic Milk Cotton Yarn, Floral Stems, Satin Ribbon, Kraft Wrap
products.careInstructions: Dust lightly with a soft brush or hair dryer on cool setting. Keep in a dry spot.

products.name: Artisan Pastel Granny Square Shoulder Tote Bag
products.description: Hand-stitched vintage-modern granny square shoulder bag in our signature palette of lilac, dusty rose, sage, and buttercream. Lined with sturdy natural canvas with an inner pocket for your phone and lip balm.
products.materials: High-density Milk Cotton Yarn, 100% Unbleached Cotton Canvas Lining, Reinforced Straps
products.dimensions: Width: 35 cm | Height: 33 cm | Strap Drop: 28 cm
products.careInstructions: Hand wash gently in cool water. Reshape while damp and dry flat on a clean towel.

products.name: Everlasting Lavender & Buttercream Tulip Bouquet
products.description: An enchanting hand-tied bouquet featuring 5 blooming tulips, 2 stems of sweet lavender, and fragrant eucalyptus leaves. Wrapped in textured craft paper and tied with a luxury satin ribbon. Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, graduations, or a cozy bedside display.
products.materials: Premium 100% Milk Cotton Yarn, Floral wire stems, Satin ribbon, Kraft packaging
products.careInstructions: Lightly dust with a soft makeup brush or blow on cool hairdryer setting. Keep away from direct dampness.

products.name: Strawberry & Daisy Heart Amigurumi Bag Charm
products.description: The sweetest little accessory for your tote or backpack! Includes a plump hand-crocheted strawberry with seeds, a petite daisy blossom, and a golden lobster clasp with heart bell.
products.materials: Milk Cotton Yarn, Anti-tarnish brass gold lobster clip & swivel keyring
products.careInstructions: Wipe metal parts with dry cloth. Spot clean yarn when needed.

products.name: Cuddle Bunny Amigurumi Soft Toy with Knit Overalls
products.description: An endearing handmade floppy-eared bunny dressed in sweet removable pastel overalls. Crafted with safety embroidered eyes and super-soft baby-friendly cotton yarn.
products.materials: OEKO-TEX Certified Organic Cotton Yarn, Anti-microbial polyfill, Embroidered details (Baby safe)
products.dimensions: Height: 30 cm from tip of ears to toes
products.careInstructions: Machine washable in a laundry mesh bag on delicate cycle or gentle hand wash. Air dry.

products.name: Blooming Blossom Crochet Coasters (Set of 4)
products.description: Protect your coffee table in aesthetic style. Set of 4 layered petal floral coasters accompanied by a handcrafted mini leaf organizer basket.
products.materials: Thick absorbant 100% natural cotton cord and yarn
products.careInstructions: Machine washable in cold gentle cycle. Lay flat to preserve floral shape.

reviews.comment: Absolutely breathtaking! The lilac and buttercream tones look even more magical in person. The craftsmanship is flawless and smells wonderful!
Bought this as an anniversary gift for my sister. She cried tears of joy! Never having to throw away dried flowers is the best thing ever.
The canvas lining is so sturdy! Fits my Kindle, wallet, and water bottle easily. Received countless compliments at my college.
